notes: Checkpoint of current-static-frontend observations for catalog checks 5–34 plus bounded subcases. Unlisted cases are not claimed in this checkpoint. The backend and datastores stopped externally during the run; after restoring them, an embedding-contract startup gate remained degraded until the API/worker were restarted against healthy dependencies. No source patches, credentials or tenant policies were changed. Initial upload was correctly rejected while degraded; its retry then completed. Public source ingestion failed embedding once and recovered on Sync now. Synthetic QA collection, fixture, public source, saved search, assistant draft and chat are retained for inspection. No schedule was created. Sequential native browser prompts blocked Save as case automation; a fresh tab reopened the saved draft. CSV export has no observed completion signal; file/bytes remain unconfirmed, and an internal downloads-page request was blocked by browser URL policy. These are modified-backend Eval observations, not clean-main certification.
